item_name: Rothco Multi-Use Tactical Wrap - Black / Security
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Multi-Use Tactical Wrap with "Security" print is a versatile essential for public safety personnel. This adaptable wrap offers over a dozen applications, including use as a neck gaiter, bandana, balaclava, or headwrap, making it ideal for security guards on the job. Constructed from moisture-wicking, wind-resistant material, it keeps you cool, dry, and protected from the elements. The lightweight, reusable design measures 19.5 inch x 10 inch and stretches to accommodate most head sizes, ensuring comfort during extended wear.
